title: Enhancing Stance Classification on Social Media Using Quantified Moral Foundations
reasoning: The paper's core focus is on enhancing stance detection by incorporating 'Moral Foundations Theory,' which proposes five distinct domains of moral concern (care/harm, fairness/cheating, authority/subversion, sanctity/degradation, and loyalty/betrayal). The methodology involves extracting and using 'moral foundation features' from text, directly engaging with the moral and ethical dimensions of social discourse.
